result.rationale: Mild non-traumatic wrist soreness without red flags is self-limited, but the question involves medication safety in pregnancy: ibuprofen (NSAIDs) is generally not recommended at 20+ weeks due to fetal renal/oligohydramnios and ductal risks, so a clinician should advise on safe alternatives (e.g., acetaminophen, rest, splinting) rather than the patient self-selecting ibuprofen.
